text: You notice a few crumpled instruction notes stuck onto the DJ Deck:
Right-click a Note Tile, and all adjacent tiles of the same color will go “pop” and disappear, forming a sound wave that blasts to the right.
The wave will fly, crash, bounce, and smack those off-key monsters until they start questioning their life choices.
After you act, it’s the monsters’ turn. They will run toward you—drive them away before they reach you!
Left-drag two Note Tiles to swap their positions.
This tuning action does not end your turn, but you only have a limited number of swaps each battle, so plan wisely!
Once you blast every enemy off the stage with your sound waves, you win.
The DJ Deck suddenly pops out a new sticky note:
Use gold to buy Effect Modules—make your waves extra shiny!
Choose one of the three modules shown in the top-left corner!
You can drag any purchased module onto any color.
You can unplug and swap them anytime—mix and match freely and create your perfect combo!
